deliverable: Recommend an initial Q2 model for one fixed 2024-2030 planting plan; do not create result2.xlsx during the trial.

shared_constraints.bean_rule: aggregate rolling-three-year area proxy, with the known spatial-coverage limitation
shared_constraints.note: These management settings are inherited for fair comparison, not stated numerical requirements in the problem.

candidates.name: deterministic midpoint MILP
candidates.method: replace every uncertain driver by its middle path and maximize seven-year profit

candidates.name: risk-neutral sample-average MILP
candidates.method: one planting plan maximizes mean profit across 80 training scenarios
candidates.role: tests whether using many futures improves average performance

candidates.name: mean-CVaR MILP
candidates.method: maximize 0.5 times mean profit plus 0.5 times the average of the worst 10% scenario profits

candidates.name: stress-robust maximin MILP
candidates.method: maximize the lowest profit among 12 named stress scenarios

common_comparison.scenario_set: 240 untouched Q2 comparison scenarios plus 12 named stresses
metrics: activation count and maximum plots per crop-season
solver status, bound, gap and wall time
common_comparison.eligibility: zero independently detected agricultural-constraint violations and profit accounting discrepancy no more than 0.1 yuan
common_comparison.recommendation_rule: First exclude invalid candidates. Recommend M2 only if it materially improves the worst-10% average over M1 without losing more than 1% mean profit. Otherwise recommend M1 when it improves mean profit over M0; retain M0 if stochastic models show no reliable benefit. M3 is selected only if its stress protection is substantial and its mean-profit cost is explicit.
common_comparison.no_global_optimum_claim: Time-limited MIP solutions are reported with their bounds and gaps.

diagnostics: evaluate every candidate under both S2 main and S1 excess-disposal stress rules
repeat evaluation with D0 and D10 seasonal-demand bases
small hand-check of a two-crop one-year CVaR example
independent final-CSV constraint and scenario-profit recalculation
stop_conditions: Stop on frozen Q1/data hash mismatch, scenario-range error, training/comparison leakage, infeasible reference plan or profit-accounting mismatch.
Do not open the 500-scenario future holdout during A-to-B trials.
Do not add correlations, crop substitution/complementarity or new parameter sources; those belong to Q3 or a newly approved Q2 plan.
After trial comparison stop at B. Do not select a final model, deepen, write result2.xlsx, freeze Q2 or enter Q3 without new authorization.
